fields.label: Value Changed
fields.description: Send when this field changes, e.g. status. In the message use {{ old_value }} and {{ new_value }}.

fields.label: Reference Date
fields.description: Date field the days are counted from, e.g. due_date

fields.label: Conditions
fields.description: Send only when all of these are true. Leave empty to always send.

fields.label: Python Condition
fields.description: Optional, for developers. Example: doc.grand_total > 1000. Checked together with the table above.

fields.label: Send to the document's customer / contact
fields.description: The mobile number of the customer (or other party) on the document

fields.label: Groups
fields.description: Telegram / WhatsApp groups (create them in Hub Chat Group). Each group gets the message on its own channel.

fields.label: Customer / Contact Fields
fields.description: Filled automatically from the document type. Change only if the mobile number is stored elsewhere.

fields.label: Mobile Field
fields.description: Mobile field in the document, e.g. contact_mobile

fields.label: Party Field
fields.description: Party field in the document, e.g. customer

fields.label: Party Mobile Field
fields.description: Mobile field in the party, e.g. mobile_no

fields.label: Prefer Party Mobile
fields.description: Use the party's number before the document's number
